consumer.authority: chooses data, payer and allowed model or tool effect

desktop.authority: broker-mediated native access and local operation journal

platform.authority: authorizes user and team requests, allocates held budgets and owns the ledger

admin.authority: scoped operator session and independent approvals

cloud_host.authority: assigns hosted workspaces and bounds each execution lease

workload.authority: only the resources and mount rights granted to one execution

supplier.authority: operating-system administrator with physical or kernel access to the supplied machine

worker.authority: carries one matching lease for an approved inference profile

merchant.authority: external test or live merchant owns its payment objects and event authentication

identity.authority: external identity issuer authenticates an account within the configured realm

publisher.authority: originates release sources, model bytes or dependency artifacts

flows: explicit source and local operation consent
account token, quote, budget and job request
separate scoped operator identity and step-up
approved administrative mutation or scoped read
signed financial event and authoritative settlement object
bounded filesystem, runtime and process resources
mTLS lease and model-specific input grant
measured result, usage and cleanup receipt
physical control, registration and contribution policy

risks.control: Only complete schema-valid arguments become candidates, followed by capability approval before effects.
risks.residual: Parsers for other modalities and OS backends require their own qualification.

risks.control: Session validity, active principal and current scoped grants are evaluated for protected Admin reads.
risks.residual: Enterprise issuer, MFA enrolment and staff operational controls need real organizational validation.

risks.control: Host admission checks live locks, uncertain journal state and prior grants before accepting CPU work.
risks.residual: Multi-GPU topology, device-level cleanup and independently attested capacity require hardware validation.

risks.control: Verify raw signed events and consult the authoritative development merchant object. A repeated fulfillment may create only one wallet credit.
risks.residual: Real merchant certification, disputed payment operations and public charging stay closed.

risks.control: Check the locked artifact digest before activating the model cache. Repeated invalid content stays unpublished.
risks.residual: A digest does not verify origin identity. Production signing, trusted update distribution and revocation require separate evidence.

risks.control: Make remote execution and data transfer visible before grant. Public devices receive only explicitly authorized model inputs.
risks.residual: The physical host can inspect plaintext during inference. Private workloads require an eligible execution domain; no hardware confidentiality qualification is asserted.

risks.control: The hosted pool owns OCI/gVisor configuration. A workload has a dedicated writable workspace, a bounded process budget and no broker credential.
risks.residual: Local Linux ARM64 validation covers one controlled payload. Production pool isolation, runtime patching and regional residency remain open.

risks.control: Persist assignment identity and accepted execution start before acknowledging replay or restart.
risks.residual: Duration and correlated partition behavior across four operating regions need independent observation.
